4421.title: Secret-type settings feedback with synthetic save adapter
4421.rootCauseOneLine: Set-state placeholder and failure alert exist; successful replacement clears draft without a new affirmative success indicator.
4421.proposedFix: Add accessible Saved feedback after successful mutations while preserving set-state and error indicators.
caveats: Synthetic placeholder and in-page adapter only; no credential persistence tested.
Current main distinguishes unset/set and failure.
